moodys.citation_text: Moody's revised MultiCare outlook to negative from stable in 2022 amid 24% debt increase, declining liquidity, and operating losses; rating Aa3.

sp.citation_text: S&P A+ on MultiCare entering 2023; downgraded to A in Oct 2023.

fitch.citation_text: Fitch held AA- with stable outlook entering 2023; revised to negative Sept 2023.

rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Fitch revised its outlook to negative on Sept. 29, 2023.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: S&P downgraded amid balance sheet deterioration. Notable FY2022 operating losses continuing through 2023; inflationary and labor headwinds may slow operating improvement.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: S&P Global downgrading MultiCare Health System's bond ratings to 'A' from 'A+' on Oct. 5, 2023 amid balance sheet deterioration.

rating_actions_in_window.rationale: Moody's affirmed Aa3 citing large revenue base, extensive footprint, good management; outlook remained negative.
rating_actions_in_window.citation_text: Moody's affirmed its rating while citing expectations that MultiCare will continue to benefit from strengths such as a large revenue base, an extensive footprint, and good management. However, the rating outlook remained negative.
